Zero double-dock collision on mobile

findings.title: Mobile Interactive Target Size Sub-44px Violations
findings.description: Mobile mode buttons, ticker controls, and alert triggers measured 32-36px, failing WCAG 2.5.5 minimum 44x44px touch target guidelines.
findings.root_cause: Desktop compact button styling reused on touch viewports without responsive padding.
original_acceptance_criteria: All interactive mobile controls measure >= 44px hit region
Touch target padding utility .touch-target applied to mobile controls

findings.title: Mobile Responsive Grid Ordering Pushes Readiness Bar Below the Fold
findings.description: On mobile layout, mandatory trade blockers and readiness status were placed after heavy technical cards, forcing excessive scrolling before decision viability could be assessed.
findings.root_cause: Desktop DOM order placed readiness bar in right rail without mobile reordering.
original_acceptance_criteria: Reorder responsive grid on mobile so readiness bar appears immediately after primary thesis
Desktop order remains unchanged in right rail

findings.title: AlertTriggerModal Missing Dialog Accessibility & Focus Trap
findings.description: Trigger Alert modal lacked ARIA role='dialog', aria-labelledby, Tab key focus containment, Escape key dismissal, and trigger element focus restoration.
findings.root_cause: Modal implemented as plain div without keyboard or focus lifecycle management.
original_acceptance_criteria: Add role='dialog', aria-modal='true', and accessible labeling
Contain Tab navigation within modal while open
Dismiss on Escape key and restore focus to trigger button
Pass AlertTriggerAccessibility.test.tsx suite

findings.original_source: Synthesis E V3 Design Audit & Directive 058A §2 Track C
findings.title: Synthesis E V3 Redesign: Full-Page Redundant Information Elimination
findings.description: Analysis page duplicates thesis sentences, factor breakdown labels, and technical parameters across 4 separate cards, creating unnecessary page length (>4000px vertical scroll).
findings.root_cause: Incremental feature additions layered new cards without deprecating legacy redundant containers.
original_acceptance_criteria: Reconcile full analysis view against approved Synthesis E V3 prototype
Consolidate duplicate explanations between summary card, confluence card, and bottom line
Reduce vertical scroll height by >= 30% while retaining all quantitative decision metrics

findings.title: Multi-Persona Acceptance Verification (Guided, Standard, Quant)
findings.description: Each terminal mode (Guided, Standard, Quant) must be verified against its persona requirements to ensure layout coherence, font hierarchy, and theme persistence.
findings.root_cause: Persona-specific testing previously conducted in isolation without unified cross-mode acceptance.
original_acceptance_criteria: Guided mode presents decision-first plain English narrative with trade setup callout
Standard mode balances technical charts with multi-pillar confluence and sizing
Quant mode presents complete factor distributions, raw DNA scores, and model telemetry
Unified Paper Light / Dark theme persists across all 3 modes
